_comment: Migration drift baseline. The .sql files listed here exist in apps/db/ but have no corresponding entry in apps/db/meta/_journal.json. They were authored via direct SQL writes (not pnpm db:generate) because the snapshot meta is stale and pnpm db:generate prompts interactively for ~30 stale rename/create decisions before reaching the new schema diff. The baseline is grandfathered: PRs that resolve a drifted file (by re-generating it through pnpm db:generate to land both the .sql + journal entry, OR by deleting it if obsolete) MUST remove the corresponding entry here. New entries land here only when journal flow is unavailable; document the addition in migrations/README.md or the PR description. See apps/db/migrations/README.md for the cutover plan.
